gates.criterion: 20 avatars in one room, one instance: p95 pose latency <= 150 ms on LAN
Downstream per avatar <= 64 kbit/s at 20 avatars
100 joiners degrade gracefully (no refusals, avatars unaffected)
gates.result: 20 avatars + 80 spectators; avatar p95 93 ms; spectators 1.4 KB/s at 2 Hz

gates.criterion: Interest management bounds per-client bandwidth when all 100 are avatars
gates.result: 5.5 KB/s per avatar at 100 avatars (vs 4.8 at 20), server tick p95 3.6 ms

gates.criterion: Cross-instance fan-out via Redis adds <= 100 ms p95
gates.result: p95 139-145 ms vs 93-95 ms single instance (+~50 ms)

gates.criterion: A flooding client is cut off without hurting others
gates.result: closed 4008 after ~3 s; others p95 94 ms

gates.criterion: Real-headset comfort + performance run on >= 3 devices (matrix below)
gates.result: not run: no hardware in this spike

gates.criterion: Harassment controls, bubble, minors policy reviewed (below)
gates.result: built for the spike; production gaps listed

gates.criterion: No camera frame reaches the page; no twin / identity in presence
gates.result: camera-access never requested; protocol carries sid + pseudonym + pose only; unit test asserts no user id on the wire

Session length nudges (break reminder after 20 min)

deviceMatrixTemplate.instructions: Fill one row per device per build. FPS from the browser's WebXR perf overlay / OVR Metrics; comfort 1-5 from 3 testers (seated + standing); 'MR place' = time from Enter to mirror placed.

rows.expected: screen tap places, DOM overlay status + exit
inline fallback; shared room works inline

controls: personal-space bubble (fade + hide label < 0.9 m)
hide (local block) per person
report -> ModerationItem VR_PRESENCE_REPORT with last 15 room events
host mute (pauses reactions) and remove (10 min ban, audited)
no free text, no voice: emoji whitelist only
gaps: no platform-level block that persists across rooms
no moderator live-join or room freeze
bubble is client-side only (a modified client can still stand inside it; it only affects what the victim sees, which is the point)

controls: token buckets per socket (pose 15/s, reactions 1/s burst 4, host 0.5/s, reports 3 then 1/20 s)
512 B frame cap, zod-validated frames
close 4008 after 150 drops / 10 s
10 tickets / user / minute
one socket per user per room
gaps: per-IP connection caps belong at the load balancer

controls: only page managers / host admins get the host role (server-side, signed into the ticket)
host shown with a gold halo + star; pseudonyms cannot be chosen
sign-in required
18+ self-attestation per join (spike policy: adults only)
'seems to be under 18' report reason
no voice, no chat, no likeness
gaps: self-attestation is not age assurance; production needs an age policy decision with counsel (Rwanda DPA Law 058/2021 + child online protection policy) before voice or open rooms

controls: pseudonym + avatar style from HMAC(user, room): stable on reconnect, unlinkable across rooms
no twin, measurements, name or phone in presence
user ids only server-side (moderation queue, audit)
MR mirror never requests camera-access; twin GLB via owner-only 5-min signed link
gaps: reports store reporter/target user ids in free text; production should use structured columns + retention

controls: flag off refuses tickets and closes every socket within ~20 s (4010; 10 s flag cache + 10 s check)
